Common Causes and Prevention and Treatment of Adverse Events Associated with Intravenous Infusion RAO You-yi，WANG Yu，MA Qing-yang（Dept. of Pharmacy，Mianyang Central Hospital，Sichuan Mianyang， 621000，China）ABSTRACT OBJECTIVE：To explore the common causes and methods for prevention and treatment of the adverse events associated with intravenous infusion，and to provide reference for rational drug use in the clinic. METHODS：Related literatures about adverse events associated with intravenous infusion were collected through the database，analyzed and classified. RESULTS & CONCLU-SIONS：The phlebitis is caused by drug toxicity，pH value，permeability pressure difference，insoluble particles，temperature and solvent of drugs；the methods of prevention and treatment included conventional treatment，hot packs and cold compresses，western medicine and TCM. The influential factors of drug exosmosis include drug，blood vessel and clinical nursing；antagonist or antidote also can be used besides hot packs and cold compresses，hydropathic compress，western medicine and TCM. Insoluble particles entering into blood vessel leads to thrombosis and granuloma，which can be prevented and treated through establishing PIVAS.KEYWORDS Venous adverse events；Phlebitis；Drug exesmosis；Thrombosis；Granuloma；Prevention and treatment静脉给药是临床上最重要的治疗措施之一，与其他给药方式相比具有作用迅速、利用度高等特点，广泛地应用于临床。但是，在静脉给药的过程中，越来越多不良事件被发现，引起了人们的高度关注。目前常见的静脉给药不良事件有静脉炎、药物渗漏、血管栓塞与肉芽肿等，本文就此介绍如下。
